solution.justification: J=[[-3/2,-1],[√3/2,0]] gives q1dot=4/√3 from the y row, then q2dot=-1-2√3 from the x row.

optionExplanations.o1: Substitution gives x velocity 1 m/s and y velocity 2 m/s.
optionExplanations.o2: This solves only the vx command and drops vy.
optionExplanations.o3: This reverses the inherited coupling sign.
optionExplanations.o4: This treats the y coefficient as 1 rather than √3/2.

solution.simpleExplanation: J=[[-3/2,-1],[√3/2,0]] gives q1dot=4/√3 from the y row, then q2dot=-1-2√3 from the x row.
misconceptions: This solves only the vx command and drops vy.
This reverses the inherited coupling sign.
This treats the y coefficient as 1 rather than √3/2.
